g.text: Private KFP on CPU K3s / Separate 60-day ML cohort
iot-versioned-distributed-training-v1. KFP carries task artifacts and
mounts the sealed workspace. Labels come from the separate cohort.
The candidate stays in the registry until an operator selects a serving build.
job admits a pinned version and performs its own deployment verification.
